title: FeDCM
summary: A research codebase for learning structural causal models in a federated setup, including a Fed_TGAN component that reimplements CTGAN-style tabular data transformation for federated training. Fed_TGAN's data_transformer.py imports ClusterBasedNormalizer from rdt.transformers and the standalone ctgan package's CTGAN class, adapting SDV-family CTGAN/RDT code into a federated data-generation pipeline.
evidence: Fed_TGAN/fedtgan/data_transformer.py:12 'from rdt.transformers import ClusterBasedNormalizer'; similarity_test.py:10 'from ctgan import CTGAN'
needs: Unclear whether CTGAN/ClusterBasedNormalizer are actually invoked or just imported; call sites not shown in evidence.
